author: The Babylon Bee
description: The Associated Press has issued a warning that medieval trebuchets, powerful weapons of war, are largely exempt from current gun safety regulations. These impressive siege engines are capable of incredible projectile motion, launching 400-pound stones at high velocity. It seems the only thing that stops a bad guy with a trebuchet is a good guy with a trebuchet, highlighting a curious loophole in modern weapon laws.
title: Associated Press Warns That Trebuchets Are Exempt From U.S. Gun Laws
